title: The Honey Show Scandal
introduction: The annual honey show has been judged, and at least two people are writing letters about it. There are 5 beekeepers. Each pays a different entry fee, from cheaper to dearer: $2, $4, $6, $8, $10. The beekeepers are Wilhelmina, Breda, Mungo, Priya and Fausto. Each enters a different honey from this list: borage honey, ivy honey, lime blossom honey, sea lavender honey, chestnut honey. Each keeps a different type of hive from this list: a long deep hive, a Langstroth hive, a national hive, a Warre hive, a WBC hive. Within each category every member belongs to a different beekeeper, so each fee, name, honey and hive type is used exactly once.
clues: The beekeeper who keeps a WBC hive pays $2, and is exactly one fee step apart from the beekeeper who enters lime blossom honey.
Wilhelmina pays exactly one fee step more than $2, with no entry fee in between.
Fausto's entry fee falls somewhere between $10 and $2 in fee order, matching neither of them.
The beekeeper who keeps a Warre hive pays a fee that falls somewhere between $2 and $6 in fee order, matching neither of them.
The beekeeper who keeps a long deep hive pays exactly one fee step more than $8, with no entry fee in between.

The beekeeper who keeps a Langstroth hive pays exactly one fee step less than Priya, with no entry fee in between, and the beekeeper who enters sea lavender honey and Priya are exactly one fee step apart.
The beekeeper who enters chestnut honey pays a fee that falls somewhere between those of Breda and Wilhelmina in fee order, matching neither of them.
Neither the beekeeper who enters chestnut honey nor the beekeeper who enters ivy honey pays $6.
Mungo does not enter ivy honey.
